view_frame: The drawing uses third-angle projection with three views: BOTTOM (XY plane), TOP (XY plane), and FRONT (XZ plane). The world coordinate system is defined with X as width (horizontal in Front/Bottom/Top), Y as depth (vertical in Bottom/Top, perpendicular to Front), and Z as height (vertical in Front). The part is a solid transition piece.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0) in XY plane at Z=0. Extends from X=-30 to X=30 and Y=-20 to Y=20.
features.evidence: BOTTOM (XY) view shows a rectangle labeled '60 x 40 mm rectangle'.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0) in XY plane at Z=60. Radius is 15 mm.
features.evidence: TOP (XY) view shows a circle labeled 'diameter 30 mm'. FRONT (XZ) view shows the top width is narrower than the bottom, consistent with a circular top of diameter 30.

features.placement: Loft connecting bottom_profile (at Z=0) to top_profile (at Z=60). The profiles are parallel XY planes sharing the same XY center (0,0).
features.evidence: FRONT (XZ) view shows a trapezoid with straight sides connecting the bottom width to the top width, labeled 'height 60 mm; solid'. Notes confirm 'Solid transition piece... straight sides'.

connections: The transition_body connects the bottom_profile at Z=0 to the top_profile at Z=60.
The bottom_profile defines the base footprint.
The top_profile defines the top face.
edit_rules: Changing the bottom rectangle width (X) or depth (Y) updates the bottom_profile and the base of the transition_body.
Changing the top circle diameter updates the top_profile and the top of the transition_body.
Changing the height updates the Z position of the top_profile and the length of the transition_body.
The transition_body must maintain a linear interpolation between the rectangular and circular profiles (loft).
